seed: A group that closes around its contents can now be told the smallest and the largest it may get, on each axis. The walk drops a starter Button and holds it open, stops it growing, and makes it taller, with one typed number each and nothing dragged.

steps.note: the starter Button, exactly as wide as its word plus its room. The Layout section's Width and Height rows now each carry a twist-open beside them, both shut, so the section is the size it always was.
the twist-open shows Smallest and Largest under Width, both empty, both saying None
THE TEST: one typed number and the pill is 200 wide with its word sitting in the middle of the room the floor made, not jammed against the left padding. Shorten the word from here and it stays 200.
emptying the box puts the limit back to none: the row says None again and the button is back to the size its word makes
THE TEST: a ceiling of 56, under the 78 the word needs, and the pill stops there. The word overhangs it, which is the honest answer until there is a way to wrap or shrink words.

THE TEST, the other axis: a floor of 72 makes the pill twice as tall and the word sits in the middle of it. Height says Fixed, so a limit holds a size somebody typed as well as one the group worked out.
